title: Storefront Checkout — guest cart + checkout composition
description: Guest-friendly shopping cart for catalog storefronts: CartProvider context with localStorage persistence (survives reload, no login needed), CartWidget header button with count badge + slide-over sheet (qty steppers, subtotal, checkout CTA), and CheckoutSummary order panel. Props-driven R3 — zero Convex imports; the host resolves numeric prices from its own catalog before add() and MUST re-price server-side at checkout (client subtotal is display-only). Pairs with doku-payment or midtrans-payment for the actual payment step; see HOST-SETUP.md for the full catalog → cart → place-order → instructions flow proven on wirausaha-os.

peers.reason: Payment step — checkout page composes DokuDirectForm + DokuPaymentInstructions (or swap midtrans-payment).
